subject: WellBe: Quick on-camera testimonial — logistics & release
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@wellbehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick video testimonial for WellBe + Redwood partnership?

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. We’ve had a lot of interest internally in putting together a short (2–3 minute) customer video that highlights how WellBe uses Redwood Inference to keep latency predictable for our chat features. Would Redwood be open to an on-camera testimonial we can use on both company sites?

High-level asks from our side:
- Short on-camera interview (2 people max)
- 1–2 short B-roll pieces (dashboard and team at work)
- Signed release form for marketing use (web, webinar, social)

We’re targeting late Feb / early Mar for filming. Can you share a sample release and an outline of logistics (crew, time on-site, run-of-show)? Also please let us know if you prefer DocuSign or we can sign a PDF and return.

Thanks — excited to collaborate.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Customer Success Manager, WellBe Health
Sara.Jenkins@wellbehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0214
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@wellbehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick video testimonial for WellBe + Redwood partnership?

Hi Sara — great to hear from you and yes, we’d love to do this. Thanks for the outline; that’s exactly the sort of scope our team can support.

High-level from Redwood:
- We can provide a small shoot crew (DP + producer) or send a lightweight kit if you prefer to keep it minimal.
- Typical on-site window: 90 minutes (45–60 minute interview + 20–30 minutes B-roll).
- Deliverables: 1 x 90–120s edited testimonial, 2–3 short social cutdowns, stills for marketing.

Would Feb 24–26 windows work for you? If you can confirm who will be on camera (names & job titles) and the filming location, I’ll coordinate crew and travel.

Attached: release_form_v1.pdf (draft) and filming_agenda_v1.docx (sample run-of-show). We prefer DocuSign but can accept a signed PDF if that’s easier for legal.

If you’d like, I can loop in Marissa on the creative and Ben on logistics/expenses.

Best,

--
Tessa Morgan
Customer Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@wellbehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick video testimonial for WellBe + Redwood partnership?

Looping in Marissa (customer content) and Ben (sales ops) to help with creative and logistics.

Marissa / Ben — Sara from WellBe wants a short customer shot (2 people on camera + dashboard b-roll). Attached are: wellbe_script_v1.docx (first-pass talking points), shot_list_v1.pdf, and the draft release_form_v1.pdf I sent Sara.

My proposed structure:
1) Intro: 10–15s — who WellBe is and the problem they solve
2) Two soundbites: 45–60s each — outcomes, why they picked Redwood, a measurable impact (latency/cost)
3) B-roll: 30–60s — product dashboard, team collaboration, office B-roll
4) Closing: 10–15s — CTA or quote we can pull for the website

Logistics notes:
- Prefer on-site San Francisco office to capture natural b-roll; otherwise we can do a minimal kit in their conference room.
- Need to confirm AV/room access and parking; will create a site contact sheet and travel budget once date confirmed.

Sara — if you can confirm participants and preferred date from Feb 24–26, we’ll lock crew and finalize the release (DocuSign link ready).

Thanks — Tessa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@wellbehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick video testimonial for WellBe + Redwood partnership?

Thanks for the ping. A few quick production / legal notes from my side: 
- Script: good start. Suggest we remove model and infra-specific product names in the on-camera lines and instead use outcome-focused language (e.g., "reduced median latency by X ms") — keeps it customer-forward and avoids engineering claims. I attached script_v2.docx with tracked suggestions.
- Consent: for enterprise customers we usually add a short compliance snippet that covers anonymized metrics and the right to redact sensitive language. See consent_snippet.txt I drafted.
- Budget: If crew needs to travel to SF, estimate ~ $1,200 (one-day shoot) unless they use local freelance crew. Please confirm whether WellBe will cover shoot expenses or if Redwood should absorb as marketing ops.
- AV: Confirm whether WellBe can provide a laptop with HDMI out or if we should bring a capture laptop for dashboard B-roll.

If Sara confirms Feb 25, I’ll start booking crew and set up a DocuSign envelope for the release.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partnerships & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0166
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@wellbehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Quick video testimonial for WellBe + Redwood partnership?

Hi all — thanks for the speedy coordination. Confirming:
- Date & time: Feb 25, 2026, 10:00–11:30 AM PT (San Francisco HQ, 3rd floor conference A)
- Participants on camera: Sara Jenkins (Customer Success Manager) and Dr. Lina Morales (VP Product)
- AV: We can provide a laptop with HDMI and a conference room with good natural light. I’ll also share our on-site AV contact and parking instructions (attached site_contact_sheet.csv).

Attached is the signed release (signed_release_wellbe_signed.pdf) — we used DocuSign and the envelope ID is in the DocuSign link above. Please proceed to book crew; WellBe is happy to cover reasonable travel & day-rate expenses (we’ll handle vendor invoices).

Next steps:
- Ben: please confirm crew & travel budget by EOD Monday so I can share with procurement.
- Marissa: can you finalize the script (script_v2.docx) and send the final talking points to Dr. Morales by Tue?
- Tessa: please send calendar invite and final run-of-show.

Looking forward — we’re excited to showcase the partnership.

Best,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
Customer Success Manager, WellBe Health
